quiz_title: Quiz 1: Number Theory, Sequences & Bitwise Logic

questions.title: Count Set Bits (Hamming Weight)
questions.problem_statement:
Write a C program to count the number of set bits (1s) in the binary representation of a given non-negative integer N.

### Input Format
A single non-negative integer `N` (0 <= N <= 2,000,000,000).

### Output Format
Print the count of set bits followed by a newline.

questions.title: Collatz Conjecture Steps
questions.problem_statement:
Given a positive integer N, compute the total number of steps to reach 1 using the Collatz rules:
- If N is even: N = N / 2
- If N is odd: N = 3 * N + 1
If N is already 1, the number of steps is 0.

### Input Format
A single positive integer `N` (1 <= N <= 100,000).

### Output Format
Print the total number of transformation steps followed by a newline.

questions.title: Sum of Multiples of 3 or 5 below N
questions.problem_statement:
Find the sum of all natural numbers strictly less than N that are multiples of 3 or 5.
If N <= 3, the sum is 0. Note that the sum can exceed standard 32-bit signed integer limits; use 64-bit integer (`long long`) for the accumulator.

### Input Format
A single integer `N` (1 <= N <= 1,000,000).

### Output Format
Print the sum followed by a newline.
